title: Normalize button gesture timing, loading affordances, and theme contrast
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Inconsistent interaction timing and loading behavior across button variants have caused visual regressions and accessibility issues. Primary problems: varied animation durations across components, spinners that shift position when themes or font sizes change, and disabled states that fall below contrast thresholds in dark/high-contrast themes. This ticket unifies gesture timing tokens, standardizes loading patterns (inline spinner vs skeleton overlay), and adjusts tokens for hit targets and disabled foreground color to resolve regressions.
acceptance_criteria: All button variants share a single interaction timing scale token (--btn-motion-duration) and a documented easing token
Loading spinner size and alignment derive from density tokens and do not cause layout shift when font or theme changes
Disabled buttons meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast in light, dark, and high-contrast themes
Icon-only buttons retain a minimum 44x44 touch target while visual icon scales per density token
Visual regression snapshots added to the Storybook suite and pass on CI
Design specs published in Figma with migration notes for developers
design_notes: Audit reveals multiple hardcoded durations (120ms, 140ms, 180ms). Consolidate to --btn-motion-duration with a 120ms default and a token-based scale for slower/faster interactions.
Prefer skeleton overlay for long-running ops (>400ms) to avoid repeated spinner flicker; inline spinner for quick ops to maintain affordance.
Hitbox padding should be separate from visual padding using --btn-hitbox-padding so layout does not change when improving touch targets.
Dark theme disabled state currently uses 50% opacity on foreground; switch to explicit disabled-foreground-color token per theme to ensure contrast.
Consider a 80–120ms micro-delay (debounce) before showing spinner to reduce perceptual flicker for sub-200ms operations. This will be optional and configurable.
We should avoid animating width/height when toggling spinner; prefer overlay or reserved inline space based on density tokens.
decisions: Default spinner placement: center-left for icon+label buttons; center for icon-only buttons
Deprecate disabled-opacity approach and introduce disabled-foreground-color per theme
Adopt dual-path loading: inline-spinner for <=400ms, skeleton-overlay for >400ms, with configurable threshold
Ship changes behind feature flag and enable gradual rollout to detect regressions
